headline: Indian IT services showed mixed growth in Q2 FY27, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while others trimmed outlooks.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest (Infosys 1.5% YoY) to very high (Coforge 53.6% YoY). Profit growth was uneven, with HCLTech up 21% YoY and Wipro profit down 1.9% YoY. AI contributions were highlighted by several firms but concrete revenue figures were limited. Guidance was cut by Infosys and introduced by HCLTech and Wipro.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Multiple companies cited AI as a profit driver, with HCLTech reporting $219 m AI revenue and Infosys noting a 29% AI revenue rise.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge and LTM delivered double‑digit YoY growth, while traditional leaders like Infosys and Wipro grew below 2% YoY.
